what: اجمع ولخّص وأعِد تشكيل الجداول (groupby وpivot_table) على ملفات CSV أو Excel. — Group, summarise and pivot tabular data from CSV/Excel with pandas.
when: any table question: totals per group, shares, top-N, month-by-channel pivots; user uploads a CSV/XLSX
how: pd.read_csv(path, encoding='utf-8-sig') -> df.groupby(key, sort=False)[cols].sum().sort_values(...) ; df.pivot_table(index, columns, values, aggfunc='sum'). Check shape against expectations (proof: 180 rows, pivot 12x3). pandas 3.x is current: check the installed version before you write code from memory.
params: encoding utf-8-sig for Arabic CSVs from Excel; keep money as integer minor units

name_ar: SQL مباشرة على ملفات CSV بـ DuckDB
what: اكتب SQL كاملًا (CTE ودوال نافذة) على ملف CSV أو Parquet دون تحميله أو إنشاء قاعدة. — Run full SQL (CTEs, window functions) over CSV/Parquet files in-process, no server, no load step.
when: joins, window functions (LAG, RANK, running totals), month-over-month, files bigger than comfortable pandas memory
how: con=duckdb.connect(); con.sql("WITH m AS (SELECT month, region, SUM(revenue) rev FROM read_csv('f.csv', header=true) GROUP BY 1,2) SELECT *, rev-LAG(rev) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY month) mom, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY month ORDER BY rev DESC) rk FROM m").df(). Proof ran a CTE + LAG + RANK + NULLIF query on the raw CSV in 0.05 s.
params: explicit column lists; NULLIF(x,0) guards; ORDER BY inside every window

what: حوّل CSV إلى Parquet مضغوط بأنواع أعمدة ثابتة، وتحقق من عدد الصفوف بعد القراءة. — Convert CSV to typed, compressed Parquet and verify the row count on read-back.
when: handing data to another tool or session; repeated queries on the same data; keeping types stable
how: duckdb: COPY (SELECT cols FROM read_csv('f.csv', header=true)) TO 'f.parquet' (FORMAT parquet); then SELECT COUNT(*) FROM 'f.parquet'. pyarrow alternative: pq.write_table / pq.read_table. Proof: 180 rows -> 3,590 B -> 180 rows.

what: جداول سريعة بمحرك Rust واستعلامات كسولة؛ الإصدار 2.0 غيّر بعض الواجهات. — Rust-backed DataFrames with lazy queries; version 2.0 changed parts of the API.
when: multi-million-row files, memory pressure, or when a lazy query plan helps
how: pl.scan_csv(path).group_by('k').agg(pl.col('v').sum()).collect(). Before writing code from memory, check `python -c 'import polars;print(polars.__version__)'`: the 2026-10-16 snapshot had 2.0.0 and its API differs from 1.x.

name_ar: ملفات CSV عربية تفتح صحيحة في Excel
what: اكتب CSV بترميز UTF-8 مع BOM حتى يعرض Excel الحروف العربية، واقرأه بالترميز نفسه. — Write CSV as UTF-8 with BOM so Excel shows Arabic, and read it back with the same codec.
when: any CSV with Arabic headers or values that a person will open in Excel
how: open(p,'w',newline='',encoding='utf-8-sig') + csv.DictWriter; read with encoding='utf-8-sig' (otherwise the first header gets a \ufeff prefix). Proof wrote and re-read 180 Arabic rows; Excel itself was not opened.

what: حُلّ المعادلات والاشتقاق والتكامل حلًا رمزيًا دقيقًا بدل الحساب الذهني. — Solve equations, derivatives and integrals exactly instead of doing mental arithmetic.
when: break-even, optimum price, closed-form answers, checking a numeric optimiser, any 'exact' number
how: Q,p=sp.symbols('Q p',positive=True); sp.solve(sp.Eq(50*Q-30*Q-120000,0),Q) -> [6000]; sp.solve(sp.diff((p-20)*(1000-10*p),p),p) -> [60] and diff twice = -20 < 0 confirms a maximum; sp.integrate(sp.exp(-x**2),(x,-sp.oo,sp.oo)) -> sqrt(pi).
section: الحساب الدقيق والإحصاء — Exact maths & statistics

what: قِس الاتجاه (انحدار خطي) وقارن مجموعتين باختبار Welch، وأبلغ عن الأثر والدلالة معًا. — Fit trends and compare groups (Welch t-test), reporting effect and significance together.
when: 'is this growing?', 'is A different from B?', before claiming a difference in a report
how: r=stats.linregress(x,y) -> slope, r^2=r.rvalue**2; stats.ttest_ind(a,b,equal_var=False). Proof: slope +8,018/month, r^2 0.706; Welch t=3.60, p=2.2e-3 on synthetic data. Report the slope or difference with units, not just p.
params: Welch by default (unequal variances); n small -> say so
section: الحساب الدقيق والإحصاء — Exact maths & statistics

what: انحدار OLS بجداول معاملات كاملة ونماذج سلاسل زمنية. — OLS with full coefficient tables, plus time-series models.
when: you need standard errors, confidence intervals and diagnostics, not just a slope
how: sm.OLS(y, sm.add_constant(X)).fit().summary(). The arsenal smoke test recovered slope 2.0 on y=2x+1.
section: الحساب الدقيق والإحصاء — Exact maths & statistics

what: حوّل الافتراضات غير المؤكدة إلى توزيعات، واحسب احتمال الخسارة والنسب المئوية بدل رقم واحد. — Turn uncertain assumptions into distributions and report P(loss) and percentiles instead of one point estimate.
when: plans, budgets and forecasts that rest on guessed inputs; 'how risky is this?'
how: rng=np.random.default_rng(seed); draw demand ~N, price ~triangular, cost ~U (100k draws); profit=units*(price-cost)-fixed; report (profit<0).mean() and np.percentile(profit,[5,50,95]). Proof: P(loss)=0.356, P5 -33,252, P50 10,570, P95 61,457.
params: N=100,000, fixed seed, state the distributions in the output
section: الحساب الدقيق والإحصاء — Exact maths & statistics

name_ar: رسم بياني بعناوين عربية في matplotlib
what: رسوم PNG ثابتة بعناوين عربية صحيحة الاتصال بخطوط محلية (Tajawal/Amiri). — Static PNG charts with correctly joined Arabic titles and labels, using bundled fonts.
when: report figures, charts for docx/pptx/pdf, social images of data
how: font_manager.fontManager.addfont('Tajawal-Bold.ttf'); rcParams['font.family']=['Tajawal','DejaVu Sans']; title with loc='right' for RTL; label bars directly; spines top/right off; muted grid. Then open the PNG and look. Proof chart.png: 78 KB.
params: dpi 110-150; one series = one hue (#2a78d6); text in ink colours, not series colour

what: matplotlib 3.11 وPillow 12 يشكّلان العربية بأنفسهما؛ إضافة reshaper+bidi فوقهما تعكس النص. — matplotlib 3.11 and Pillow 12 shape Arabic themselves; adding reshaper+bidi on top reverses the text.
when: before drawing any Arabic in matplotlib or Pillow; when you see reversed or unjoined Arabic
how: RAQM=getattr(matplotlib.ft2font,'__libraqm_version__',None); text = s if RAQM else get_display(arabic_reshaper.reshape(s)). For Pillow: PIL.features.check('raqm'). Proof: libraqm 0.10.5 in both wheels; mpl_arabic_modes.png shows raw (correct) vs reshaped (reversed).

name_en: Validate chart colours with the dataviz checker
what: شغّل مدقق ألوان مهارة dataviz (التباين، شريط الإضاءة، عمى الألوان) بدل الحكم بالعين. — Run the dataviz skill's palette validator (contrast, lightness band, colour-blind separation) instead of eyeballing.

how: Load the dataviz skill if the host lists it, then `node <skill>/scripts/validate_palette.js "#hex,#hex" --mode light` and again `--mode dark`. Fix every FAIL. Proof: #2a78d6 (light) and #3987e5 (dark) PASS all checks.

source: host skill dataviz (listed in this session)

what: رسوم تفاعلية بتلميحات وتكبير في ملف HTML؛ الحجم الافتراضي كبير لأن المكتبة تُضمَّن كاملة. — Interactive HTML charts with hover and zoom; by default the whole library is inlined, so the file is large.
when: an exploratory chart someone will open in a browser; not for print
how: px.bar(df,x,y).write_html('c.html', include_plotlyjs='cdn') to avoid inlining the library. The arsenal run inlined it and got 4.8 MB; the 'cdn' variant was not timed. PNG export needs kaleido + Chrome.

what: رسم تصريحي يُخرج JSON بمواصفة Vega-Lite يمكن عرضه في صفحة ويب. — Declarative charts that emit a Vega-Lite JSON spec for a web page.

what: توزيعات وعلاقات بسطر واحد فوق matplotlib. — Distributions and relationships in one line, on top of matplotlib.

how: sns.histplot(data); sns.boxplot(x=,y=,data=). Then apply the same Arabic/font rules as matplotlib.

what: تصنيف وانحدار وتجميع بخطوط معالجة موحدة. — Classification, regression and clustering through uniform pipelines.
when: tabular prediction, clustering customers, baseline models before anything heavier
how: Pipeline([('scale',StandardScaler()),('m',RandomForestClassifier(random_state=0))]); evaluate with cross_val_score, never with the training score. The arsenal smoke test fitted iris; its training score of 1.0 shows the API works and says nothing about accuracy.

what: أقوى خط أساس للبيانات الجدولية. — The strongest baseline for tabular data.
when: tabular prediction where a random forest plateaus
how: xgb.XGBRegressor(n_estimators=...).fit(X,y); lgb.LGBMRegressor(verbose=-1). Use early stopping on a validation split. Both ran fit/predict in the arsenal snapshot.

what: احسب التوليفة المثلى تحت القيود بمحلّل HiGHS، وتحقق من الرأس بحل دقيق. — Find the optimal mix under constraints with HiGHS and confirm the vertex exactly.
when: allocation, product mix, schedules, budgets with limits
how: optimize.linprog(c=[-40,-30], A_ub=[[1,1],[2,1]], b_ub=[40,60], bounds=[(0,None)]*2, method='highs') (negate to maximise) -> x=y=20, profit 1,400; confirm with sympy.solve on the two binding constraints.

what: محللات Google للبرمجة الخطية والصحيحة والقيود والمسارات. — Google's solvers for LP, MIP, constraint programming and routing.
when: integer decisions, scheduling, vehicle routing, assignment
how: pywraplp.Solver.CreateSolver('GLOP') for LP, 'SCIP'/'CBC' for MIP; cp_model.CpModel() for CP-SAT. The arsenal GLOP run maximised 3x on [0,10] to 10.0. Do not import pulp 4 (highspy) and ortools in the same Python process: both bundle HiGHS, so ortools fails with ImportError (undefined symbol in libortools) or pulp reports "HiGHS: Not Available". Use separate processes or venvs.

what: الصيغة القديمة LpVariable وPULP_CBC_CMD تفشل في PuLP 4؛ المحلّل المتاح HiGHS. — The old LpVariable/PULP_CBC_CMD style fails in PuLP 4; the available solver is HiGHS.
when: any code you remember from PuLP 2.x/3.x
how: x=m.add_variable('x',0,4); m.solve(pulp.HiGHS(msg=False)); pulp.listSolvers(onlyAvailable=True) -> ['HiGHS']. If you need OR-Tools instead, run it in a separate process or venv. Do not import pulp 4 (highspy) and ortools in the same Python process: both bundle HiGHS, so ortools fails with ImportError (undefined symbol in libortools) or pulp reports "HiGHS: Not Available". Use separate processes or venvs.

what: صُغ مسائل التحسين المحدّب كما تُكتب رياضيًا. — Write convex optimisation problems the way they look on paper.
when: portfolio weights, least squares with constraints, regularised fits
how: x=cp.Variable(); cp.Problem(cp.Minimize((x-2)**2)).solve() -> 2.0 (arsenal run).

what: أثبِت قيودًا منطقية وعددية أو جد حلولًا لها (ألغاز، جداول، تحقق). — Find or rule out solutions to logical/integer constraints (puzzles, rosters, verification).
when: 'is there any assignment that…', configuration checks, puzzles
how: a,b=z3.Ints('a b'); s=z3.Solver(); s.add(a+b==10,a-b==4); s.check(); s.model() -> a=7,b=3 (arsenal run). unsat is itself a proof of impossibility.

what: أقصر مسار ومركزية ومجتمعات على شبكات العلاقات. — Shortest paths, centrality and communities on relationship networks.
when: dependencies, org charts, routes, social graphs
how: nx.shortest_path(G,a,b); nx.pagerank(G); nx.community.louvain_communities(G). The arsenal run returned the shortest path on path_graph(5).

what: مساحات ومسافات وإسقاطات وتجميع مكاني على بيانات جغرافية. — Areas, distances, projections and spatial joins on geographic data.
when: per-city/area aggregation, distances, buffers; data feeding maps
how: gdf.to_crs(3857) before measuring metres; Transformer.from_crs(4326,3857,always_xy=True). The arsenal run gave Cairo lon 31.2 -> x 3,473,168 m.

what: تنبؤ بسلاسل زمنية فيها موسمية وأعياد. — Forecasts for seasonal time series with holidays.

name_ar: احسب في الكود ثم جمّد ثم اروِ
name_en: Compute in code, reconcile, freeze, then narrate
what: كل رقم دقيق يأتي من كود، ويُطابَق بطريقتين مستقلتين، ويُجمَّد في ملف، ثم يُكتب النص من الملف. — Every exact figure comes from code, is reconciled two independent ways, frozen to a file, and the prose is written from that file.
when: any answer, report, dashboard or slide that contains numbers
how: 1) compute; 2) control totals: plain csv sum == pandas == SQL, and subtotals add back to the total; 3) write results.json; 4) generate text/HTML from results.json, never by retyping; 5) if something does not reconcile, report the gap and never plug it. Proof: 3,281,841 matched three ways and the dashboard reads the frozen numbers.
params: integer money units; expected row count asserted
source: owner: KOSIF SEE v1.7.5 skills/kosif-finance-data (paraphrased in own words); implemented in proofs/general-data/make_data.py

what: لا SELECT *، وأسماء CTE واضحة، وحماية من القسمة على صفر، وعدد صفوف متوقع يُتحقق منه. — No SELECT *, named CTEs, divide-by-zero guards, and an asserted expected row count.
when: every query whose result feeds a decision
how: Name the columns; use NULLIF(den,0); assert COUNT(*) against the expected grain (12x5=60); compare SUM to an independent total; sample-check five rows by hand. Proof query follows all of these.

what: فصل المدخلات عن الحسابات عن المخرجات، دون أرقام مثبّتة داخل المعادلات، مع خلايا فحص تساوي صفرًا. — Separate inputs, calculations and outputs; no hard-coded numbers inside formulas; check cells that must equal zero.

how: Sheets: Inputs (blue font, units, source), Calc (formulas only), Outputs (links only), Checks (balance - assets + liabilities = 0; sum of shares = 100%). Scenario overrides live on Inputs. Recalculate with LibreOffice (DOC-03) before you quote anything.
